string-array.name: diet_tagline_idle_morning
string-array.item: Keep the first light of morning for yourself
Every day is a good day. — Yunmen Wenyan
Go slowly, and enjoy the view. — Zhu Guangqian
Pay attention. Be astonished. Tell about it. — Mary Oliver
Good morning. Take it slow
A new day, whenever you're ready

string-array.name: diet_tagline_idle_afternoon
string-array.item: Busy day? Remember to look after yourself
Let the afternoon sun sit with you a while
You deserve to be treated kindly today too
Tired? Pause and take a breath
Go have some tea. — Zen master Zhaozhou
Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience. — Ralph Waldo Emerson
Good afternoon
What's on your plate?

string-array.name: diet_tagline_idle_evening
string-array.item: Long day. And here you are
The evening breeze is gentle, and so are you
Home yet? Let yourself unwind
Any small good moments today?
Where the heart finds peace, there is home. — Su Shi
With no idle worries on your mind, every season is a good one. — Wumen Huikai
Good evening
How was your day?
Capture tonight's flavors

string-array.name: diet_tagline_idle_night
string-array.item: It's late. Gently set today down
Good night. See you tomorrow
Sleep well. Everything else can wait
The moon is here, and so am I
Rest is not idleness. — John Lubbock
It's late, rest well
Tomorrow is a fine start too
A quiet night

string-array.name: diet_tagline_eating
string-array.item: Eating well is a way of loving yourself
This bite is a small kindness to yourself
Eat slowly. This moment is yours
Good food deserves to be remembered
Spend some time with flavors you love
The truest flavor in life is simple joy. — Su Shi
People who love to eat are always the best people. — Julia Child
If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world. — J.R.R. Tolkien
You're eating!
Enjoy this meal
Savor every bite
Snap a tasty moment
Eat slowly, taste fully

string-array.name: diet_tagline_eating_winding_down
string-array.item: Did this meal make you happy?
Keep a little of the taste with you
Thank you, little meal, for the company
Smile, breathe, and go slowly. — Thich Nhat Hanh
Window closing soon
Enjoy the last bites
Feeling satisfied?

string-array.name: diet_tagline_fasting_just_started
string-array.item: Your body is slowly taking in the warmth
From here, let your body do the work
Knowing others is wisdom; knowing yourself is clarity. — Laozi
Your fast has begun
Freshly fed, time to rest
Letting your body digest

string-array.name: diet_tagline_fasting
string-array.item: I'm here, walking slowly beside you
Feeling hungry is okay. It's your body talking
Sip some warm water. Give yourself a hug
Be still and listen to your body
You are enough, right now
Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience. — Ralph Waldo Emerson
Knowing others is wisdom; knowing yourself is clarity. — Laozi
You're fasting!
Fasting alongside you
Your body is resting
Notice how you feel

string-array.name: diet_tagline_fasting_almost_there
string-array.item: Almost there. I've been with you the whole way
A little longer, then a good meal
Deep breath. Slow is just fine
Walk to where the water ends; sit and watch the clouds rise. — Wang Wei
Almost there
Just a little longer
Nearly at your target time

string-array.name: diet_tagline_success
string-array.item: You're here. Thank you for caring for yourself
When you're ready, enjoy a good meal
Eat when hungry, sleep when tired. — Dazhu Huihai
Every day is a good day. — Yunmen Wenyan
You did it!
Next meal, whenever you're ready
